gate.title: This module is off.
gate.body: Turn it on in Settings › Activity and modules to use this screen.

template.seed: Create the template's categories and services
template.pick: Choose the closest activity: it turns the right modules on. You can change it later in Settings › Activity and modules.
template.resets: The modules and the till screen become the template's. Nothing is deleted.

settings.activityHelp: The template chooses the modules and the till screen; you can then set them one by one here.
settings.modulesHelp: A module that is off hides its screens and refuses its operations; its data stays.

regulated.title: Selling above a capped price
regulated.help: A line sold above the price the law caps (bread, milk, semolina…) warns the cashier, or is refused.

minOrder.title: Minimum order
minOrder.help: A line below an item's minimum order (wholesale) warns, or is refused.

flexy.title: Flexy operators
flexy.help: For each operator: the top-up product sold at the till and the commission you earn (the flexy sales report counts it). An operator without a product is not sold.

repairs.readyHelp: The text copied to tell the customer their device is ready, in their language. {shop}, {item}, {number} and {amount} are replaced.
repairs.conditionsHelp: Printed at the foot of the slip handed to the customer at intake, in their language.
repairs.uncollectedHelp: After that, the item shows in "Not collected".

reminders.daysHelp: A due shows in the reminders this many days before its date.
reminders.messageHelp: The text copied to remind the customer of a due, in their language. {shop}, {amount}, {number} and {date} are replaced.

keptDeposit.title: Kept deposits
keptDeposit.help: When a customer gives up an order and the shop keeps the deposit, the deposit is sold as this product (a service).
keptDeposit.none: No product: deposits cannot be kept

restaurant.name: Restaurant
restaurant.help: Floor plan first, then tickets per table.

wholesale.name: Wholesale
wholesale.help: Customer required, customer prices and minimum quantities.

mixed.name: Mixed
mixed.help: Retail till with a Tables button (café + grocery).

department_keys.name: Department keys
department_keys.help: Price typed at the till for products without a code.

regulated_prices.name: Regulated prices
regulated_prices.help: Warning or block above the regulated price.

yield.name: Cutting yield
yield.help: Carcass cut into pieces, cost shared out.

waste.name: Daily waste
waste.help: Breakage, unsold goods and own use.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy
pharmacy.help: Generic names (INN), generics, Chifa reference price, controlled medicines register.

serials.name: Serial numbers and IMEI
serials.help: Entered at the sale, checked at the return.

flexy.name: Flexy
flexy.help: Top-ups per operator, float and commissions.

wholesale.name: Customer prices and minimum order
wholesale.help: Prices per customer, packs, delivery note as invoice.

orders.name: Orders and layaway
orders.help: Deposit, reserved stock, sold once fully paid.

jewellery.name: Jewellery
jewellery.help: Price per gram, special register, hallmarks.

scale.title: Scale
scale.help: Plug the scale in, choose its port, then detect it. You can do it later in Settings › Hardware.

departments.title: Department keys
departments.empty: No department key has been created yet.

serial.title: Serial number — {{name}}
serial.notInStock: This number is not in stock for this product.

buyer.title: Buyer (special register)
buyer.hint: The jeweller's special register records the identity of the buyer of a precious-metal piece.
buyer.name: Full name

van.title: Sell from the van
van.pick: Choose the van of a round on the road.
van.none: No round is on the road.

voucher.title: Voucher
voucher.unknown: No voucher and no deposit has this code.
voucher.spent: This voucher is already fully used.
voucher.otherCustomer: This deposit belongs to another customer: choose them first (F3).
